name: CaseBoxShadowOkStack
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "box-shadow-ok-stack" (effects). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a TWO-layer elevation whose every layer colour is an OKLab spelling — the drop half of astryx's `shadow-med` (examples/astryx/tokens/astryx.dtcg.json) COMPUTED-ENRICHED (extract/computed): unlabeled styled channels minted from computed-style capture of @ds-contracts/conformance@0.1.0 in headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34; overflow channels in the sibling extension file.
